1.21.1.0.1181.0:
**Community ×3 · New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · New Content ×1 · Train ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1181.0

**Grander, more common fancy rooms in dimensional carriages**

The fancy rooms inside dimensional carriages have been reworked with new quartz and deepslate pillars and finer stair detailing, and they now turn up far more often. Library rooms appear a little less often to make space for them.

- Fancy dimensional carriage rooms have new pillar and stair detail
- Fancy rooms now appear about five times as often
- Library rooms appear less often

### 0.1180.0

**Trash your own photos**

When you look at a photo you've just taken, a trash button now sits beside the X. It burns the photo, and no other passenger will ever find it.

- Paying Tribute to a photo now tells you how many emeralds it cost and how many more people will see it.
- The chat lines that follow your photos are shorter.
- Hovering the buttons under a photo now shows a plain Trash, Close or Tribute.

### 0.1179.0

**Credits on the website**

The Credits are now on the website at brennan.games/dungeontrain/credits/ — every translator, writer, builder, funder and community member, with each list's top contributor standing beside it as an animated player in their own Minecraft skin.

- The top translator, writer, builder, funder and community member, each in their own skin
- Renames and Anonymous choices from the in-game Credits page carry over
- Linked from the front page of the website

### 0.1178.0

**Smoother loading-screen stories**

The stories told on the loading screen have been re-punctuated so they read more naturally.

### 0.1177.0

**Community photo sharing fixes**

Small fixes to how community photos are shared.
1.21.1.0.1176.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1176.0

**New Photography Advancements**

The camera's advancement tab has new hidden advancements to discover.

### 0.1175.0

**Photos are rarer in bookshelves**

Chiseled bookshelves hand out photos about half as often as before, so finding one feels special again.

### 0.1174.0

**Photo & Tribute leaderboards**

Thirteen new leaderboard books for the camera: who takes the most photos, who pays the most Tribute, whose photos other passengers honour most, and who has spent the most emeralds doing it.

- Most Photos Taken, Most Photos Tributed, Passenger Portraits, Bravest Photographer and Wildlife Photographer, each with an All Lives and a One Life board
- Most Tributed Photographer counts only Tributes other players pay to your photos
- Most Emeralds Tributed and Most Expensive Tribute count Tributes to your own prints and to other players' photos
- Passenger, monster and animal boards fill from photos taken from this update on
1.21.1.0.1173.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1173.0

**No more stacked flowers**

Flowers and grass in carriage gardens, animal pens and dimensional carriages now grow one block tall on the floor, instead of sometimes stacking a second flower on top of the first. Tall grass, ferns and tall flowers still grow two blocks tall.

### 0.1172.0

**Tributed Photos Get Their Own Channel**

Photos you pay Tribute to now go up in their own channel on the Dungeon Train Discord, so every kept photo is in one place instead of mixed in with the passenger log.
1.21.1.0.1169.0:
**Bug Fix ×3 · New Feature ×1 · Translations ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1169.0

**Translator credit fixes**

Community translators are credited correctly for their work.

- Ukrainian translation updates.

### 0.1167.0

**New Game works on Turkish-language computers**

If your computer's language was set to Turkish or Azerbaijani, starting a New Game showed the loading screen and then dropped you straight back to the main menu. Worlds now load normally, and your in-game language and number formatting are unchanged.

### 0.1166.0

**Player Mobs only take your camera to photograph you**

Player Mobs used to pocket any camera they found, even with no intention of using it. Now a mob picks up a camera only when you throw it to them and they're willing to take your photo. Cameras in chests, lying on the floor, or thrown at a mob that's fighting you are left alone.

### 0.1165.0

**Know when your version is out of date**

Joining a game on an old version of Dungeon Train now tells you once, in chat, how many releases behind you are, with a link to update. It waits until you're actually in the world so it doesn't scroll past under the loading screen, and it won't repeat when you come back to the same game.
1.21.1.0.1164.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1164.0

**A camera's worth of advancements**

Your books and photos now share an advancement tab of their own, and the camera has plenty to earn — the people, creatures and places you capture along the line. Every photo that earns one is kept: hover the advancement to see the shot, and click it for the full print.

- Biome advancements now count every biome the train takes you through — and ask for more. Everyone earns them again.
- Fixed an advancement tab that sometimes took several clicks to open.
1.21.1.0.1163.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Translations ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1162.0

**Tribute your own photos**

Took a photo worth sharing? Pay Tribute to your own print and it's posted to the passenger log on Discord for everyone to see — and it reaches twice as many players before it fades. The first Tribute in a life costs 3 emeralds; each one after costs three times the last.

- Pay Tribute to your own fresh photo to post it to the passenger log on Discord
- A tributed photo can be seen by twice as many players before it fades
- Costs 3 emeralds, tripling with each Tribute that life

**Translators can now fix every plural form**

In the in-game translation editor, the extra plural rows some languages need — Ukrainian, Russian, Polish and Romanian count things in three ways where English has two — showed no English text and refused to save anything with a number in it. They now show the English they stand for, so those lines can be corrected like any other.

- Plural rows show their English original instead of "not supplied"
- Save works on those rows again — a %s is no longer reported as foreign
1.21.1.0.1161.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Translations ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1161.0

**Human translations only**

Prefer English over machine translation? A new switch on the Language screen shows only translations a person wrote or reviewed. Anything still machine-translated and unreviewed appears in English instead. It's off by default.

- New person button at the top right of the Language screen turns it on or off, instantly
- Lines translated or reviewed by the community stay in your language
- In single-player, unreviewed books and item names follow the same choice
1.21.1.0.1160.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · Community ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Translations ×1 · Mobs ×1**

### 0.1160.0

**Videos: click a platform to see just that one**

On the Videos page, clicking a platform icon now shows only that platform's videos, and clicking it again brings everything back. Shift-click still shows or hides just one, so you can mix and match.

- Click YouTube, Bilibili, Twitch, Instagram or Twitch streamers to see only that one
- Shift-click to show or hide a single platform
- The same video list is now on the website too: brennan.games/dungeontrain/videos/

### 0.1159.0

**Dungeon Train speaks Ukrainian**

Ukrainian joins the language list — the whole game, not just the menus: every screen, the item names and all 57 in-game books, plus the Sable and Discord Presence menus in the modpack. The bulk is machine translation marked with the faded AI mark, but it already carries MrMultibite's community translations as human-reviewed text; if you read Ukrainian, the in-game translation editor is open and your fixes come back to everyone.

- Ukrainian (Українська) is selectable in the vanilla language list
- Menus, HUD, advancements, item names and all 57 books translated
- Counts follow Ukrainian grammar — 1 вагон, 3 вагони, 5 вагонів
- MrMultibite's approved translations shipped as human-reviewed text

### 0.1157.0

**Spider jockeys arrive with their skeleton**

The rare spider jockey that can turn up in a carriage now spawns with its skeleton rider in place. Before, the skeleton was missing — and could appear later out of nowhere.

### 0.1155.0

**Build submissions show their version**

Builds submitted for review now show which version of Dungeon Train they were made on, with a coloured dot for how up to date it is.

### 0.1154.0

**Ride-photo resolution shows 720p**

Snapshot Max Resolution now offers 720p, in Options and the X menu. After using Lower resolution on the Performance tab, the setting reads 720p instead of AUTO.
1.21.1.0.1154.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Performance ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Loot ×1 · Books ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1154.0

**Far terrain rests while you're paused**

Pausing the game now also pauses far-terrain generation, so a long break no longer leaves the game sluggish when you come back.

**Photos survive a broken chest or bookshelf**

Photos no longer burn when the bookshelf, chest, barrel or pot holding them is broken. They drop intact and only burn once you look at them or throw them away.

### 0.1151.0

**Lectern stories unfold in a better order**

The letters you find on lecterns now arrive in a more deliberate order, so the stories make more sense as you read them.

- A family's letters now come in the order they were written, one person's story leading into the next
- A few stories turn up sooner, and some now wait until you have read the rest

### 0.1150.0

**Performance tips in Options**

Options → Dungeon Train… has a new Performance tab. It lists every setting that affects how smoothly Dungeon Train runs, checked against your setup, with a button to each one. The tips that would help you come first.

- The tips you used to see only after reporting lag are now always one click away
- Each tip opens its setting: Video Settings, Shader Packs, Distant Horizons, Dungeon Train Settings, or lowers ride-photo resolution right there
- Shows how many releases behind you are, with a link to what changed
1.21.1.0.1149.0:
# Capture The View

What did you see on train? What did the train see of you?
Find disposable cameras in the loot and snap with a click. Your shots travel down the line into other passengers' bookshelves, barrels and chests, and theirs find you. Pay tribute to a photo to keep it travelling. A new page on the death screen.

## Other significant updates

- A villager get tired of repeat sales, and devalue the items he has to many of.
- Finding you own library has never been easier, sign a book and the chances multiply until you find one next. New and improved author rooms.
- THE LADDER BUG IS DEAD
- New carraiges.
- Many train editor improvements.
- Improvements to the translation editor
- New and improved connections to discord.
- More loading screen lore.
- Bug fixes
- Performance improvements

**New Feature ×26 · Bug Fix ×18 · Community ×17 · Compatibility ×9 · World ×9 · Menus & UI ×9 · Loot ×7 · Editor ×6 · Train ×6 · Balance ×6 · New Content ×3 · Mobs ×3 · Performance ×2 · Books ×2 · Advancements ×2 · Translations ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1148.0

**More cargo and flatbed carriages**

Boxcars, cargo carriages and flatbeds now come up more than twice as often, and the standard carriage's pillars pick from a tidier set of wood and stone.

- Boxcars, cargo and flatbed carriages are more common
- Carriage pillars mix stripped logs, planks and stone bricks

### 0.1147.0

**More photos on the shelves**

Chiseled bookshelves turn up community photos about four times as often. When there are no photos left to find, a photo slot now gives you a player book instead of sitting empty, and disposable cameras turn up a little less often.

### 0.1146.0

**Feedback posts count your answers**

Each feedback post to Discord now notes how many times you have answered that question, in brackets at the end of its small tag line — so a fifth take on the same question reads as one.

**Hand a PlayerMob a camera and it takes your photo**

PlayerMobs now pick up dropped disposable cameras. Toss one to a PlayerMob that is on good terms with you and not busy fighting: it raises the camera, lines you up and takes your picture, then hands you the print and the spent camera burns as yours do. The photo is credited to the PlayerMob by name and shows up in the passenger log on Discord. A PlayerMob that dislikes you keeps the camera and takes no photo.

- Dropped cameras are something PlayerMobs want — they pick them up like any valuable
- Gift one to a friendly PlayerMob and it photographs you, viewfinder up, then tosses you the print
- Prints are credited to the PlayerMob's name, in game and in the Discord passenger log

### 0.1145.0

**Villagers tire of what you keep selling them**

Selling one item over and over to the same villager now pays less each time. The first few sales pay full price, then the price eases down. The villager slowly gets its appetite back over a few in-game days. Red bars on the trade row show how much less it's paying.

- The first 8 emeralds' worth of any item still sells at full price
- Every villager keeps its own tally, so a different villager pays full price again
- Up to three red bars on the Trade Anything row: one once the price drops, two below 75%, three below half

### 0.1144.0

**All the dynamic-lights mods count for fair play**

Sodium Dynamic Lights, RyoamicLights, Dynamic Lights Reforged and Dynamic Lights now join LambDynamicLights on the approved-mods list, so running one no longer puts you into Free Play.

### 0.1143.0

**FIXED THE LADDER BUG!**

Helll yeahhhhh

### 0.1142.0

**Disposable cameras on the train**

Disposable cameras now turn up in the train's chests, barrels, bookshelves and pots. While the train is still short of community photos, a spot that would have held one may hold a camera instead, so you can go and take more.

- Find one-shot disposable cameras in the train's loot
- Fewer community photos to find? You're more likely to find a camera in their place

### 0.1141.0

**No more bare islands in the stranger stretches**

Some islands in the stranger stretches of the journey came through as flat bare stone right beside lush, overgrown neighbours. They now wear the same scenery as everything around them. Only newly generated ground is affected — stretches you have already crossed keep their look.

- Bare stone islands now get their scenery.
- Only newly generated ground changes; existing worlds keep what they have.

### 0.1140.0

**No Nether mobs in the mountain caves**

Zombified piglins and magma cubes no longer spawn in the overworld caves inside the mountains around the Nether crossing. They only appear where the ground is actually Nether.

**Repairs keep your dye**

Repairing dyed leather armour in the crafting grid now keeps the left item's colour, just like its trim.

### 0.1139.0

**Libraries that fit their writer**

Dimensional carriages that hold a writer's library now choose a room sized to that writer's shelf — a handful of books gets a cosy study, a prolific writer gets a grand hall — and three new library rooms join the rotation.

- Three new library rooms can now appear behind dimensional carriages
- Each library is picked to fit its writer, so a few books aren't lost in an empty hall
- Once you've signed a book, your own library is sized to how much you've written
- Rooms of run statistics only appear where there's shelf space for the whole set

### 0.1138.0

**Choose what suspicious sand and gravel dig up**

Builders can now set the loot inside suspicious sand and suspicious gravel from the loot menu, just like a chest. Brushing one on the train turns up a single item from that list, and blocks left alone still give their usual archaeology finds.

- The loot menu (C) now opens on suspicious sand and gravel
- Each block rolls one item from its list, with an optional chance of finding nothing

### 0.1137.0

**Two new loading-screen stories**

Two more verses join the loading screen's rotating story. One asks why the train looks the way it does, and what you see when you look at it. The other wonders who really built the train.

- New stories: "Why does the train look that way?" and "Some ask of how the train was built?"
- Both are translated into every supported language

### 0.1136.0

**Feedback and resubmit verdicts are announced too**

When the reviewer sends a submitted build back with feedback, or asks for it again from a newer version, that now posts to Discord's build-submissions channel alongside accepts — so the whole conversation about a build sits in one place.

### 0.1135.0

**Player heads look into the room**

Player heads placed around carriage rooms now turn to face into the room, each picking a slightly different angle so no two trains look quite the same. A head in the middle of a room can face any way.

- Heads look toward the centre of the room, give or take a quarter-turn either way, never at the wall behind them

### 0.1134.0

**Drifting carriage fix**

Fixed an issue with drifting carriages.

### 0.1133.0

**Your submitted builds now come back with a verdict and a note**

When a build you submitted for review has been looked at, My Builds now tells you what was decided — accepted, feedback, not accepted, or 'resubmit from a newer version' — with the reviewer's comment right beside it. Accepted builds are announced in Discord's build-submissions channel.

- Four outcomes, each with a note from the reviewer: accepted, feedback, resubmit from a given Dungeon Train version, or not accepted. The tile's border and icon in My Builds say which, and the comment sits under the build.
- A build sent back for a version waits until you submit it again from that version — Submit for Review tells you which one it needs.
- If you have a chat thread with the dev, the verdict and comment also arrive in your in-game inbox.

### 0.1132.0

**Rotate heads, banners and signs in 8 directions**

Heads, skulls, standing banners and signs placed on the floor can now be given a rotation in the block variants menu. Lock one direction, or pick any of the 8 compass points for each spawn to choose from.

- Lock cycles through N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W and NW
- Options opens a compass rose so you can tick the directions you want
- Mirroring and rotating a plot turns these directions along with the block

**Luggage, a new carriage, and a rebuilt parkour room**

Some book carriages now have travellers' luggage piled up in them. A new carriage design joins the train. One of the parkour dimensional carriages has been rebuilt and keeps turning up much further into a run. Shop carriages come up a little less often.

- Luggage piled up in some book carriages
- A new carriage design on the train
- A rebuilt parkour dimensional carriage that appears deeper into a run
- Shop carriages are slightly rarer

**Tributed photos show how far they travelled**

A tributed photo in the passenger log now shows how many passengers have held it and how close it came to fading, printed on the same worn, torn paper it had when you paid. Only your biggest tribute yet gets posted, so to share a photo with everyone, pay more than you ever have before.

- The passenger log shows how many hands a tributed photo has passed through
- The posted picture keeps its worn paper and torn edges
- Only a tribute bigger than any you've paid before is posted

### 0.1131.0

**Other players' photos turn up in the train**

Photos other players have shared can now be found in bookshelves, barrels, pots, villager stock and more across the train. Meals are a little more generous with the basics.

- Shared player photos join ten kinds of train loot
- Builders can place a Random Player Photo straight from the Narrative creative tab

### 0.1130.0

**Take photos with either click**

Holding a camera up to your eye, a left-click now takes the photo too, just like a right-click. The camera's hover text is tidier as well — no more slide count or slide-swapping hints.

- Left-click or right-click takes a photo through the viewfinder
- Camera hover text no longer lists slides

### 0.1129.0

**Your translator credit stays as you set it**

On the Help Translate send screen, the name you want to be credited by, and whether you want credit at all, no longer reset when you resize the window or alt-tab out of fullscreen.

### 0.1128.0

**Tributed photos are shared with everyone**

When someone pays tribute to a photo, the whole passenger log gets to see it.

**Photos travel the train**

A photo you take may now turn up for another passenger further down the line, and theirs for you.

### 0.1127.0

**Straight back aboard**

Every Dungeon Train world now opens straight away after an update.

### 0.1126.0

**A clean slate**

Opening another world after leaving one no longer carries a stray piece of the old one with it.

### 0.1125.0

**Know when a new version is out**

A short note now appears before the main menu when a newer version of Dungeon Train is out.

### 0.1124.0

**Dimensional carriages remember your visit**

Dimensional carriages now stay as you left them when you come back.

### 0.1123.0

**Photos on the death screen**

When the ride ends, the photos from your life get a page of their own.

### 0.1122.0

**Rendering hiccups**

A rare rendering hiccup no longer ends your ride.

### 0.1121.0

**Disposable cameras keep to themselves**

Only the disposable camera you shoot with reloads now, and every shot prints a single photo.

### 0.1120.0

**The first passenger to earn an advancement is remembered**

Be the first passenger ever to earn an advancement and the whole train hears about it.

### 0.1118.0

**Fewer hitches as new scenery loads**

Big buildings ahead now load quietly in the background, even after a long jump.

**World mod updates no longer stop the game loading**

The game keeps loading when one of the world mods it builds on updates.

### 0.1116.0

**World generation fix**

Some of the world's shapes now build a little more reliably.

**Bare islands grow back**

Some islands far down the line now carry the growth and rock they were always meant to, instead of standing bare.

### 0.1115.0

**The rarest advancements make the passenger log**

When someone earns one of the train's rarest advancements on a clean run, the passenger log hears about it.

### 0.1114.0

**Smoother scenery**

The scenery colours in a little more smoothly as new ground comes into view.

### 0.1113.0

**Build the buildings**

The Train Editor has a new Buildings tab, where you can change the buildings the world places or add your own and share them.

### 0.1112.0

**Giant mushrooms and layered rock keep their shape**

Giant glowing mushrooms and bands of coloured rock now come out whole and the same every time, however many places the world is being built at once.

### 0.1111.0

**Feedback says a little more**

Feedback you send now carries a little more about your game, so it is easier to act on.

### 0.1110.0

**Tidier Stage Blocks tab**

The Stage Blocks creative tab is grouped into rows by material, and every stage block shows its icon.

### 0.1109.0

**Photographs burn when dropped**

A photograph now burns if you drop it.

### 0.1108.0

**Copies of community books**

Copies of community books no longer ask for your vote.

### 0.1107.0

**Ride photos stay properly framed**

Ride photos keep their normal framing while you're zoomed in.

### 0.1106.0

**Two new required mods**

Dungeon Train now needs Exposure and Exposure: Polaroid installed, and the launchers add them for you.

### 0.1105.0

**Villager sell-back prices tuned**

Villagers now pay a set price for bells, name tags and a handful of other things they stock.
1.21.1.0.1104.0:

### 0.1104.0

**Narrative tab shortcut**

The creative inventory's left edge now has a shortcut to the Dungeon Train narrative tab.

### 0.1103.0

**Longer carriages**

Some carriages on the train are now much longer.

### 0.1102.0

**Your own library turns up when you've written something**

A dimensional carriage is more likely to open onto a library of your own books after you've written one.

**See what others are up to**

You can now see what the players riding with you are doing.

### 0.1098.0

**Main menu tidy-up**

Small main menu tidy-up.

### 0.1097.0

**Carriage group builds keep their variants and loot**

Carriage group builds made in the Train Builder now keep their block variants and chest loot when saved and shared.

### 0.1096.0

**Editor Menus setting stays put**

The editor's Editor Menus setting now stays as you left it when you test a carriage.

### 0.1095.0

**Tidier joins between terrain styles**

With the optional border-blending setting on, trees and other features now stay with their own terrain where two styles meet.

### 0.1094.0

**Leaving a world**

Leaving a world no longer crashes the game now and then.
1.21.1.0.1093.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Editor ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Multiplayer ×1 · Community ×1 · Translations ×1 · World ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1093.0

**Supported mods**

Internal changes to how supported mods are handled, to meet CurseForge's requirements.

### 0.1092.0

**Things that grow**

Vines, glow berries, ladders, bamboo, dripstone and more can now grow into longer columns in your builds, and the overgrown tunnels hang a little lower.

### 0.1091.0

**Shift exits on the pause menu, on servers too**

Holding Shift on the pause menu now reveals the Exit to Title and Quit Game buttons on a server as well, with Disconnect still there when Shift is up.

### 0.1089.0

**An ode to Monty Python**

Something out there may now introduce itself with a name that Monty Python fans will recognise.

### 0.1088.0

**Build editor messages in your language**

The build editor's quick messages above the hotbar now speak your language.

### 0.1087.0

**Submitted builds show their picture**

Builds submitted for review from the editor now arrive with their picture, whole rooms included.

### 0.1086.0

**Bug reports from /bug and /feedback get an answer**

Sending a bug report with /bug or /feedback now replies in chat with what might help.
1.21.1.0.1085.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Menus & UI ×3 · Translations ×2 · Community ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Loot ×1 · Books ×1**

### 0.1084.0

**See your translation where it appears**

Translators can now preview their text in place — on a book page, a button, a tooltip, the death screen, in chat and more — before saving.

### 0.1083.0

**Your bug reports get an answer**

Report a bug after a fall and the train now tells you whether help is already on the way.

### 0.1082.0

**Know who's speaking**

Translators can see more info about the characters they're translating for.

### 0.1081.0

**Echoes leave their mark**

Gear an echo leaves behind now remembers who it belonged to.

### 0.1077.0

**Leaderboard eras and Ancient Records**

The one-life leaderboards now belong to eras. When a balancing release changes what a good run is, the boards are retired and a fresh set opens for the new version; each calendar year gets its own boards too. Nothing is lost: every retired board is kept for good, and The Tallyman's books about them keep turning up in loot as Ancient Records, naming the game versions their numbers came from. Players still on an older version keep scoring on their own era's boards.

- One-life boards (distance, carriages, time aboard, chests, echoes, friends, pacifist and no-chest runs) reset per game version; all-lives totals and contribution boards stay all-time.
- Retired boards stay readable and circulate as Ancient Records books: about one loot book in forty, and one per retired era on the Stat Room's shelves. The server setting retiredLeaderboardBooks turns them off.
- Each year has its own one-life boards alongside the version boards.
1.21.1.0.1080.0:
**Bug Fix ×6 · Compatibility ×6 · World ×6 · New Feature ×5 · Performance ×4 · Train ×3 · Behind the Scenes ×3 · Community ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · New Content ×1 · Editor ×1**

### 0.1080.0

**Trash slot won't keep holding items when menu closes**

Anything still sitting in the trash slot that hasn't been intentionally deleted now comes back to you when you close your inventory.

### 0.1079.0

**Feedback shows your version**

Feedback you send from the game now says which version of Dungeon Train you were playing.

### 0.1078.0

**Cargo carriages**

Cargo carriages turn up in more shapes along the line.

### 0.1077.0

**Islands arrive whole**

Floating scenery no longer shows up as bare squares when you arrive somewhere in a hurry, and the world builds itself a little faster there.

### 0.1076.0

**Steadier train**

The train no longer jumps.

### 0.1075.0

**Lighter on memory after busy stretches**

The game now lets go of memory it no longer needs once you've ridden on past the world's busiest stretches.

### 0.1073.0

**Plants stay rooted**

Plants along the line now only grow where they can stand.

**No more hard edges**

Some scenery now carries on past where it used to stop.

### 0.1071.0

### 0.1023.0

**A heads-up when Minecraft is short on memory**

If your launcher gives Minecraft too little memory, the game can stutter and freeze as it runs out. Dungeon Train now tells you when that's the case and shows you how to fix it in your launcher.

- A notice on the title screen when Minecraft has under 5 GB of memory and your computer has more to give
- "How to do it" opens a step-by-step guide for your launcher: CurseForge, Modrinth App, the Minecraft Launcher, Prism, MultiMC or ATLauncher
- The modpack now recommends 6 GB of memory
- Turn it off with "Don't show again", or in Options > Dungeon Train > Low Memory Warning
